pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/13900

As I mentioned in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/13896#discussioncomment-1012208, my original calculations assumed a scroll distance of 480px. But hitobjects only scroll to the hit position, which is 402px.

Comparison vs stable values:
```
SpeedMania.RelativeSpeed = 40 * 100 / (60000 / speedChanges[0].BeatLength)
28.5714285714286
SpeedMania.TimeAt(speedChanges[0].BeatLength, 402)
287.14285714285711

SpeedMania.RelativeSpeed = 1 * 100 / (60000 / speedChanges[0].BeatLength)
0.714285714285715
SpeedMania.TimeAt(speedChanges[0].BeatLength, 402)
11485.714285714286
```

Or can be calculated manually by `402 * (60000 / 100) / 21 / 40` (explained previously in https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/9868#issuecomment-675327188).

issue_context.title: Mania scroll speed does not match the numbers in stable
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/13896
Originally posted by **Morilli** July 15, 2021 **Describe the bug:** I noticed that the displayed scroll speed number (1 - 40) does not match the scroll speed of stable. I have no idea what the "correct" math is but I don't think I'm able to find out easily. Example: Scroll speed of 13720ms (1, the lowest you can go) in lazer results in ~10000 milliseconds time between seeing the note for the first time and being able to hit it, whereas a scroll speed of 1 in stable gives ~11500 milliseconds. None of these numbers make any sense to me given that it says 13720ms. Another example for the opposite case, aka 340ms (40): Lazer time between seeing the note and hitting it: about 20 frames on my 60fps recording, aka ~333ms. Stable time: 17 frames on a 60fps recording, so around 283ms. I was timing from the first frame any part of the note was visible to the frame in which autoplay hits the note, in the standard skin. **osu!lazer version:** 2021.707.0

review_comments: fwiw this did not fix anything for me when testing locally with maximum scroll speed selected.
Can you describe what issue you're seeing? This is intended to help with *minimum* scroll speed, not maximum.
I wouldn’t have been able to make the screenshot in the description without this, so I doubt that. Are you testing on a different/more extreme beatmap or something?

I was specifically testing the same map that I linked in the issue, but I've seen the same thing on any map using any skin.
Here's what I'm seeing: 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35152647/125959941-95cc0a82-de22-4d5a-9126-43a084392a3a.mp4

Any other settings that could affect this?

Ah, I see what's going on. It looks like the one that actually needs to change is the lifetime entry's offset, because that determines when the hitobject first gets applied. But that also has an actual overhead if applied to the same value, so I'm less keen to change it.

@ekrctb You had changes before that calculated the lifetime without requiring DHO sizing and all that, do you still think that's going to happen sometime? `InitialLifetimeOffset` is quite flaky...
@smoogipoo I don't have immediate plan to address that as I couldn't figure out how to do change in a backward compatible manner.
